what: The big title melts in line by line — each line enters at 92% width as a blob blurred at 12% of the font size, and because of the contrast threshold (×18) on the whole title it becomes one fused lump of ink, as the blur shrinks with power3.out the lump splits into thickly spread letters and sharpens. .8s per line, the next line .32s later (the first .2s). When everything has settled, the filter is removed and the original text is left as is

options.on: load (default) · scroll (when entering the screen, needs ScrollTrigger)
options.dur: Time for one line to form (sec), default .8
options.blur: Initial blur — share of font size, default .12
options.start: on: ScrollTrigger start for scroll, default top 85%

use:
Headline line oneLine two

· The ground to paint is --fx-ground (default --kf-bg), and the threshold strength is --fx-contrast

from.where: index.js liquidReveal — three-line hero big heading (original titlefx.js: delay .2 · gap2·gap3 .32 · dur .8 · blur .12 × glyph size, black plate over the contrast)

note: While it spins, the area behind the title box is filled with the background color (the original also briefly shows a black box on a red panel). If the background is an image, set --fx-ground to the dominant color of that spot
